evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: There is a complex tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: There is mild heterogeneous signal intensity of the chondral surfaces consistent with mild chondromalacia.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: There is mild heterogeneous signal of the cartilage without evidence of a discrete defect.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is severe chondromalacia patella.
evidence.Contusion: There is mild subcortical marrow edema in the femoral condyles, medial tibial plateau, patella, and femoral trochlea likely related to osteoarthritis.
evidence.Fracture: Possible minimal occult insufficiency fracture medial tibial plateau.
